environment.runtime: x64 Windows console in a Hyper-V-isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 Rust build running in the same container
environment.input: Win32 console key events, including Ctrl state and hardware scan codes
environment.fixtures: Generated raw files with distinct byte patterns

history.layout: Cyan panel, inset double border, dark gray close marker and black background shadow
history.table: Mode and offset in the top border, vertical separators in each row, white-on-black selection, and a bullet for marked visits
history.workflow: Keep a.bin in Hex at offset 0x200, open b.bin from Files, open History and observe both positions, toggle its mark and path display, dismiss Help, remove the inactive entry, and switch between History and Files

arguments.layout: Untitled cyan panel, inset double border, centered argument count in the bottom border, and an unlabeled function bar
arguments.workflow: Display names in command-line order, move the highlight, cancel without changing the document, then move to the following argument and wrap forward and backward

comparison.method: Compare aligned console cells inside each dialog, including the border, close marker, selection, and palette. Verify the black background of the offset shadow and compare the settled function bar separately.
comparison.limits: The paired list region excludes the underlying view and nested Help. In the two Ctrl+Backspace opening frames, HIEW shows the transient Ctrl bar. The candidate shows the settled bar. Persistent history, all modifier layers, and the full platform matrix remain open.
